capabilities: Insert Caute card links as chips via a command or the @@ trigger
Quote passages from saved pages, PDFs, books, emails and recordings with source links
Ask questions and save model-written answers with linked sources as notes
Convert card links into footnotes or sources lists from card properties
Publish notes to the Caute library and search or browse it in a sidebar pane
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README details exactly which data leaves the vault and states Caute keeps nothing from Obsidian except published notes; sign-in is stored in Obsidian's secret storage, not the vault. Caute offers a free plan.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to connect to a Caute capture library for linking cards, quoting sourced passages, or searching saved reading.
summary: Caute integration that links, quotes and searches saved cards and passages, answers questions from your library, and publishes notes to Caute.
